abstract: Reflections, glare, transparent structures, and material-dependent appearance variations can introduce ambiguity into RGB-based visual perception in vehicle-relevant environments. Polarization provides complementary reflection- and material-sensitive information, but its acquisition requires dedicated sensing hardware. This paper presents RGB-P Wild, a real-world dataset containing 10,000 paired RGB and four-angle linear-polarization image sets, together with PolarVis, a diffusion-based framework for recovering polarization representations from a single RGB image. PolarVis combines hierarchical RGB feature extraction, diffusion-based feature refinement, four angle-specific decoders, and multi-scale attention recalibration to reconstruct polarization intensity images at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$. On RGB-P Wild, PolarVis achieves a normalized-domain MSE of 0.0465, a PSNR of 27.83 dB, and an SSIM of 0.8597. Compared with the released PolarAnything model under the adopted evaluation protocol, PolarVis obtains an AoLP error of $25.66^\circ$ and a DoLP MAE of 0.0404, compared with $46.03^\circ$ and 0.1084, respectively. Cross-dataset evaluation on vehicle-mounted imagery further examines transfer beyond the training domain. In downstream evaluation, a frozen PCDNet achieves AP50/AP50:95 of 86.3%/59.1% on 990 RGBP-Car test images using PolarVis-generated polarization, compared with 87.0%/59.8% using measured polarization. These results indicate that RGB-derived polarization retains useful polarimetric information for the evaluated perception tasks, while remaining distinct from calibrated physical polarization measurements.
abstract_zh: 反射、眩光、透明结构和材料依赖的外观变化可能会给与车辆相关环境中的RGB视觉感知带来模糊性。偏振提供了补充的反射和材料敏感信息，但其获取需要专用的传感硬件。本文提出了RGB-P Wild，这是一个包含10,000对RGB和四角线性偏振图像集的真实世界数据集，以及PolarVis，一个基于扩散的框架，用于从单个RGB图像恢复偏振表示。PolarVis结合了分层RGB特征提取、基于扩散的特征精炼、四个角度特定解码器和多尺度注意力重新校准，以重建$0^ ext{°}$、$45^ ext{°}$、$90^ ext{°}$和$135^ ext{°}$的偏振强度图像。在RGB-P Wild上，PolarVis实现了0.0465的归一化域均方误差（MSE）、27.83 dB的峰值信噪比（PSNR）和0.8597的结构相似性指数（SSIM）。与发布的PolarAnything模型在采用的评估协议下相比，PolarVis获得了$25.66^ ext{°}$的AoLP误差和0.0404的DoLP平均绝对误差（MAE），而后者分别为$46.03^ ext{°}$和0.1084。对车辆安装图像的跨数据集评估进一步检验了超出训练领域的迁移能力。在下游评估中，冻结的PCDNet在990张RGBP-Car测试图像上使用PolarVis生成的偏振达到了86.3%/59.1%的AP50/AP50:95，而使用测量的偏振则为87.0%/59.8%。这些结果表明，基于RGB的偏振保留了对评估感知任务有用的偏振信息，同时与经过校准的物理偏振测量保持明显区别。
summary_zh: 本文面向恶劣驾驶场景中的视觉感知问题，发布RGB与四角度偏振配对数据集RGB-P Wild，并提出扩散模型PolarVis，从单幅RGB图像生成偏振表示。生成的偏振信息在下游车辆感知任务中取得接近真实偏振测量的性能，有助于在不部署专用偏振传感器的情况下增强反光、眩光和透明物体场景的感知能力。
title: PolarVis: A Dataset and Diffusion Framework for RGB-to-Polarization Perception in Adverse Driving Scenes
title_zh: PolarVis：用于恶劣驾驶场景中RGB到偏振感知的数据集和扩散框架
